mark.note: squad-banner VIP mark (A4), shown at 48 px, 3x master; loop cord on top, tassel below

chest.note: level-up gift chest, shown at 96 px (2x master)

ring_bronze.note: inner circle centre x,y and diameter in px of this rect; draw at scale avatar_d/192

ring_silver.note: inner circle centre x,y and diameter in px of this rect; draw at scale avatar_d/192

ring_gold.note: inner circle centre x,y and diameter in px of this rect; draw at scale avatar_d/192

ring_vip10.note: inner circle centre x,y and diameter in px of this rect; draw at scale avatar_d/192

frame_v5.note: hole = inner window [x,y,w,h] px of this rect; portrait_small 160x238 sits behind it

frame_v10.note: hole = inner window [x,y,w,h] px of this rect; portrait_small 160x238 sits behind it

f8_body.note: VIP 8 frame (copy 1) without ribbons, 160 px wide

f8_ribR.note: ribbon layer, draw UNDER f8_body at off (relative to the f8_body rect top-left); sway 2-3 px, 2.4 s loop, pivot = top attach point
